purpose: Scientific-visualization style + color policy + movement rules for Profile B. Goal: scientifically defensible visual realism, not photorealism or sci-fi. Every color's meaning is declared; every movement type is evidence-tagged.

style.realism_level: biologically recognizable, disciplined scientific-illustration (BioRender/Cell-Press style principles, not copied assets); not cartoonish, not horror, not decorative sci-fi
style.cell_shape: true-to-type (corneocyte flat/anucleate; keratinocyte polygonal; melanocyte/B16 dendritic-or-spindle; fibroblast spindle)
style.membrane: smooth bilayer line; junctions where real (desmosomes in epidermis)
style.ecm: intentional fibrillar pattern (dermal collagen bundles), not random noise
style.nanoparticle: uniform spheres ~85-90 nm class (B1); DISTINCT deliberate color, declared as illustrative
style.encapsulated_vs_free_API: encapsulated = tint inside the particle; released/free = separate small glyphs/dots
style.nucleus: shown in nucleated cells only; NEVER in corneocytes
style.uncertainty_visualization: ghosted/hatched rendering + amber badge for INFERRED_RISK / qualitative events
style.labels_arrows_trails: trails allowed for diffusion (random-walk look), not directional 'swimming'

rules: H&E pink/purple, trichrome blue = STAIN_DEPENDENT, never presented as natural tissue color
concentration/depth encoding = DATA_ENCODING_COLOR with a legend
do NOT reuse red for blood AND concentration AND danger AND therapeutic effect - pick distinct hues
every major view carries a LEGEND declaring each color's class

movement_rules.render: biased random walk (NOT constant-speed straight lines)
contact + ordinal glow; NO detailed endocytosis machinery for B1
ER close-up for B2; PROHIBITED for B1

movement_forbidden: exact concentration fields without quantitative data
